metadata.description: Publish self-contained HTML artifacts to your own SFTP web host with a stable URL and private-by-default visibility, then read them back from a local archive.

plugins.name: artifact-sftp
plugins.description: Publish one self-contained HTML file per artifact to an SFTP web host and get a stable private-by-default URL. Includes local artifact read-back and an interactive setup skill that pins and verifies the SFTP host key.
